records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.sortable_table.is_missing#1
records.source: This includes ``None``, blank strings, ``NaN``, pandas ``NA``, and ``NaT``. After the ``None`` and string checks, the result of ``pandas.isna`` is converted to ``bool``. A single-element array containing a missing value can therefore return ``True``; ambiguous multi-element results return ``False``.
records.context: This includes ``None``, blank strings, ``NaN``, pandas ``NA``, and ``NaT``. After the ``None`` and string checks, the result of ``pandas.isna`` is converted to ``bool``. A single-element array containing a missing value can therefore return ``True``; ambiguous multi-element results return ``False``.
records.translation: 这包括 ``None``、空白字符串、``NaN``、pandas 的 ``NA`` 和 ``NaT``。完成 ``None`` 和字符串检查后，会将 ``pandas.isna`` 的结果转换为 ``bool``。因此，包含缺失值的单元素数组可以返回 ``True``；包含多个元素且真值不明确的结果返回 ``False``。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.sortable_table.install_sorting#1
records.source: Accepts a ``QTableWidget``, ``QTreeWidget``, or ``QTableView``. A ``QTableView`` with a non-proxy model is wrapped in :class:`SortableProxyModel`. An existing ``QSortFilterProxyModel`` is preserved with its own comparison behavior; a view without a model is not wrapped. Call this function immediately after ``setModel`` and obtain the view's selection model afterwards.
records.context: Accepts a ``QTableWidget``, ``QTreeWidget``, or ``QTableView``. A ``QTableView`` with a non-proxy model is wrapped in :class:`SortableProxyModel`. An existing ``QSortFilterProxyModel`` is preserved with its own comparison behavior; a view without a model is not wrapped. Call this function immediately after ``setModel`` and obtain the view's selection model afterwards.
records.translation: 接受 ``QTableWidget``、``QTreeWidget`` 或 ``QTableView``。对于模型不是代理的 ``QTableView``，会使用 :class:`SortableProxyModel` 包装。已有的 ``QSortFilterProxyModel`` 会保留其自身的比较行为；没有模型的视图不会被包装。请在 ``setModel`` 之后立即调用此函数，然后再获取视图的选择模型。
